entities.name: Allowed NSSAI
entities.description: Information element that contains the network slice selection assistance information allowed by the network for the UE.

entities.name: REGISTRATION REQUEST
entities.description: NAS message sent by UE to initiate registration procedure.

entities.name: Requested NSSAI
entities.description: Information element containing the network slices requested by the UE.

entities.name: S-NSSAI
entities.description: Single Network Slice Selection Assistance Information identifying a network slice.

entities.name: Network not supporting NSSAA
entities.description: Condition where the network does not support Network Slice-Specific Authentication and Authorization.

entities.name: S-NSSAI not subject to NSSAA
entities.description: Condition where S-NSSAI is not subject to Network Slice-Specific Authentication and Authorization.

entities.name: NSSAA successfully performed
entities.description: Condition where Network Slice-Specific Authentication and Authorization has been successfully completed.

entities.name: Default S-NSSAI available
entities.description: Property indicating the network has one or more default S-NSSAIs configured.

relations.description: REGISTRATION REQUEST message contains the Requested NSSAI information element.
Requested NSSAI contains one or more S-NSSAIs.
When network does not support NSSAA and S-NSSAIs are allowed, Allowed NSSAI IE shall be included.
When S-NSSAIs are not subject to NSSAA and are allowed, Allowed NSSAI IE shall be included.
When NSSAA has been successfully performed for S-NSSAIs, Allowed NSSAI IE shall be included.
When no requested NSSAI is allowed but default S-NSSAIs exist, Allowed NSSAI IE shall be included.
